_note: Synthetic fault code table for a demo. Codes, meanings and part numbers are invented.

codes.title: Cell voltage deviation high
codes.meaning: Spread between the highest and lowest cell group exceeded 150 mV while the pack was under load.
codes.check: Compare cell min and max under peak current. A spread that only opens under load points to one weak cell group.

codes.title: Pack over temperature
codes.meaning: Pack temperature above 58 C.
likely_causes: Ambient heat with sustained high current
codes.check: Check pack temperature against current over the same window.

codes.title: Charge taper error
codes.meaning: Charging stopped early because the charge taper table rejected the requested current.
likely_causes: Cell group out of balance at high state of charge
codes.check: Check the firmware version against service bulletins before replacing hardware.

codes.title: Contactor weld detected
codes.meaning: Main contactor did not open on command.
codes.check: Replace contactor assembly after an isolation test.

codes.title: Isolation resistance low
codes.meaning: Isolation between high voltage and chassis fell below 500 ohm per volt.
likely_causes: Moisture in a high voltage connector
codes.check: Dry the connectors and repeat the isolation test before replacing parts.

codes.title: Phase overcurrent
codes.meaning: Phase current exceeded the 450 A hardware limit and the inverter shut its gates.
likely_causes: Current sensor drift in the inverter
codes.check: Look for current spikes above 450 A with normal inverter temperature. Spikes with a cut and restart point to the inverter current sensing.

codes.title: Gate driver desaturation
codes.meaning: A power stage left saturation during switching.
codes.check: Replace the inverter if it repeats after a reset.

codes.title: Inverter over temperature
codes.meaning: Inverter heatsink above 95 C, torque derated.
codes.check: Check coolant flow first.

codes.title: Motor over temperature
codes.meaning: Motor winding temperature above 140 C, torque derated.
codes.check: Check coolant flow against motor temperature over the same window.

codes.title: Motor position encoder fault
codes.meaning: Encoder signal lost or implausible.
codes.check: Inspect the encoder connector.

codes.title: Coolant flow low
codes.meaning: Coolant flow below 1.0 L/min while the drive unit is hot.
codes.check: Flow that drops to near zero while the pump is commanded on points to the pump or its connector.

codes.title: Coolant over temperature
codes.meaning: Coolant above 75 C.
codes.check: Check coolant flow.

codes.title: Throttle signal implausible
codes.meaning: The two throttle tracks disagreed for more than 100 ms and torque was cut.
codes.check: Dropouts that line up with chassis shocks point to the connector, not the sensor.

codes.title: Throttle sensor out of range
codes.meaning: A throttle track voltage left its valid range.
codes.check: Replace the throttle sensor if it repeats at rest.

codes.title: Charge port moisture detected
codes.meaning: The charge port moisture sensor read wet at plug in.
codes.check: Ask about washing before charging. Check humidity at plug in.

codes.title: Charge port isolation fault
codes.meaning: Isolation fault between charge pins and chassis during charging.
codes.check: Dry the port and repeat the isolation test.

codes.title: Charger communication lost
codes.meaning: No messages from the charger for 2 s.
codes.check: Try another charger.

codes.title: Impact event recorded
codes.meaning: The inertial unit measured an acceleration peak above 6 g.
codes.check: An impact right before other faults means the faults follow the impact.

codes.title: Tip over detected
codes.meaning: Lean angle above 80 degrees at low speed.
codes.check: Check for impact damage.

codes.title: Display bus timeout
codes.meaning: The dash stopped answering on the body bus.
codes.check: Inspect the display harness and mount for impact damage.

codes.title: Body bus off
codes.meaning: The body CAN bus went bus off.
codes.check: Unplug nodes one by one.

codes.title: Torque limit active
codes.meaning: The vehicle controller cut torque to protect a component.
likely_causes: Any battery, drive or cooling protection
codes.check: Find the protection fault logged right before it.

codes.title: Limp mode
codes.meaning: Torque limited to 20 percent until restart.
codes.check: Find the fault that triggered limp mode.

codes.title: Firmware compatibility warning
codes.meaning: One controller runs firmware older than the minimum in the current release.
codes.check: Update all controllers to the current release.

codes.title: Regen disabled
codes.meaning: Regenerative braking disabled because the pack is full or cold.
likely_causes: Normal at 100 percent charge or below 0 C
codes.check: No action when the pack is full or cold.
